hypothesis: C66's full-history regression is caused primarily by committing seven chunks at once; training the identical C66 mechanism from the same fresh C58 parent while committing only the latest complete chunk should retain clean-over-shuffle sensitivity without exceeding the 5% clean-versus-off regression gate.

references.title: C66 context-length diagnostic
references.revision: SHA256 50a726dd6bc69fa185c9c9bf17cac9ed138d9d8ef6a229b886d44af76c241237; trained best context window k1

single_variable.change: Commit only the latest complete history chunk (2 observations, 8 executed actions) instead of all seven; preserve absolute frame/action/update coordinates.
invariants: same C58 fresh parent and frozen INT8 H3
same C66 model code, flow objective, AdamW optimizer and 100-step eight-rank budget
same full seven-chunk H3 materialization before bounded commit
single_variable.falsification: Fail if clean-k1 does not beat distinct previous-chunk action shuffle by 1%, clean-k1 regresses more than 5% versus context-off, restore is not exact, or any source/data/gradient identity gate fails.

evidence: Fail-closed remote auditor passed all reviewed C66 source, frozen data, fresh parent, INT8 H3, failed C66 report/checkpoint and k1-selecting diagnostic identities.
Focused tests cover one-chunk reduction, distinct shuffle donor, absolute 15/56/14 post-commit coordinates, artifact contract and fail-closed permission.
Formal clean/shuffle/off MSE is 0.0821909424/0.0828969684/0.0780162402: clean-over-shuffle 0.851691% misses the >=1% gate and clean-versus-off regression 5.351068% exceeds the <=5% gate.

The formal runtime_restore_exact false is an evaluation precision-scope false negative, not a state defect: read-only v2 replay found exact snapshot tensors and absolute coordinates on 64/64, with matched-scope original/restored max-abs 0. Cross-scope formal comparison alone was nonzero on 64/64 with maximum 0.0234375.
This experiment does not run or authorize rollout.

decision.rationale: The restore gate false negative is fully explained by mismatched BF16 autocast scope and does not indicate a serialization or prefix defect. Independent efficacy gates still fail exactly as preregistered, so no long training, threshold change, rollout or promotion is authorized.
